questions.question: Explain what the 3 and the 8 mean in the fraction three eighths, and why the parts of the whole must be equal.
questions.expected_answer: The 8 is the denominator: the whole is cut into 8 equal parts. The 3 is the numerator: we are talking about 3 of those parts. The parts must be equal because a fraction name like eighth describes the size of each part; pieces of different sizes cannot all be one eighth.

questions.question: A chocolate slab has 8 equal blocks and 3 are eaten. Write the fraction eaten and the fraction left, and explain how they are related.
questions.expected_answer: Three eighths is eaten and five eighths is left. Together they make eight eighths, which is the whole slab, because the shaded and unshaded parts always add up to one whole.

questions.question: Use a fraction wall to explain why one half is bigger than one quarter, and why two fifths is smaller than one half.
questions.expected_answer: On the wall all strips are the same length. The half strip is cut into 2 parts and the quarter strip into 4, so each quarter is smaller than each half. Two fifths does not reach as far along the wall as one half, so two fifths is smaller.
